column1: # Curated newsgroups — the groups worth indexing, so a fresh install doesn't
# face ~100,000 groups with no idea which carry real content.
# Rows are INSERT-ONLY: seeding adds groups that aren't present and never
# touches ones that are. A group you enabled, disabled, or deleted stays exactly
# as you left it across upgrades.
# Seeded groups arrive INACTIVE on purpose — this is a curated picker list, not
# an instruction to start crawling fifty groups on first boot. Enable the ones
# you want in the admin wizard.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # are comments.
#   name   the newsgroup, exactly as the server lists it
#   pack   which pack it belongs to: anime | movies | tv | music | books | misc
#          (a row can only be in one pack; ship the same group twice if it
# GENERATED CONTENT: populate this from a real, running indexer rather than by
# hand — an install that has actually been crawling knows which groups carry
# content. See scripts/export-newsgroups.sh, which dumps exactly this format:
# Unlike the coverage ranges, group names ARE portable — every provider carries
# the same group names, so a pack exported from one install is meaningful on any
# other. (Article NUMBERS are the per-backbone part; names are not.)
